0022600226.text: The Trail Blazers (6-3) host the Thunder (8-2) in the Trail Blazers' 11th game of the season, with Portland 1-2 at home, 5-1 on the road, and on a two-game losing streak, sitting 3rd in the Northwest and 8th in the West. Oklahoma City, 1st in the Northwest and 3rd in the West, is 5-0 at home and riding a four-game winning streak. Portland is without Ja Morant (hamstring), Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery) and Vit Krejci (ankle), while Oklahoma City is missing Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Jaylin Williams (back spasms) and Thomas Sorber (knee). The teams have not met yet this season, and in 2025-26 the Trail Blazers lost the season series 1-3, including a 124-95 loss in Oklahoma City on December 31.
